summary: This process calculates and generates the monthly salary for selected employees based on their assigned salary templates and payable days.
steps: Ensure "Pay Birthdays" (payable days) are set for the employees.
Select the desired "Month" and "Year" for which salary needs to be processed.
Click "Go". A list of employees will appear.
Search for a specific employee or select multiple employees from the list.
business_rules: Salary processing relies on the assigned salary template and the number of "Payable Days" (attendance/working days) for the month.
important_notes: A confirmation message like "Added" indicates that the salary has been successfully created for the selected employees.
questions: How do I process salaries for my employees for a specific month?
What are the prerequisites for processing employee salaries?
Where can I find the option to process monthly salaries?
